mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.UNIV_ID, MD.DEPT_ID, M.PASSWORD, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.ROLE, M.PHONE_NUMBER, M.GENDER, M.STATUS, M.CREATED_AT, M.LOGTIME_AT, M.BIRTH, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.LOGIN_ID, M.UNIV_ID, MD.DEPT_ID, M.PASSWORD, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.ROLE, M.PHONE_NUMBER, M.GENDER, M.STATUS, M.CREATED_AT, M.LOGTIME_AT, M.BIRTH, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND M.UNIV_ID = #{univId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, MEMBER_NAME, ROLE, PHONE_NUMBER, GENDER, STATUS, CREATED_AT, LOGTIME_AT, BIRTH ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{memberName}, #{role}, #{phoneNumber}, #{gender}, #{status}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{birth} )
INSERT INTO LOGIN_LOG ( LOG_ID, MEMBER_ID, RESULT, FAIL_REASON, LOG_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_LOGIN_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{result}, #{failReason}, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO LOGIN_SESSION ( SESSION_ID, MEMBER_ID, REFRESH_TOKEN, CREATED_AT, EXPIRED_AT, REVOKED_AT, IP_ADDRESS ) VALUES ( SEQ_LOGIN_SESSION.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{refreshToken}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP + 7, NULL, #{ipAddress} )
mapper.select: SELECT SESSION_ID, MEMBER_ID, REFRESH_TOKEN, IP_ADDRESS FROM LOGIN_SESSION WHERE REFRESH_TOKEN = #{refreshToken} AND REVOKED_AT IS NULL AND EXPIRED_AT > SYSTIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE LOGIN_SESSION SET REVOKED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE REFRESH_TOKEN = #{refreshToken} AND REVOKED_AT IS NULL
